description: Defensive service-version categories inspired by vx-underground-style collection sorting. This taxonomy does not contain malware samples, exploit procedures, IOCs, target data, or vulnerability proof-of-concept material.

categories.label: Unknown fingerprint
categories.meaning: A service is exposed but the scanner did not identify a usable product/version.
categories.recommended_action: Manually identify the service and decide whether version disclosure, hardening, or retirement is needed.

categories.label: Versioned service review
categories.meaning: A product/version was detected but no local lifecycle baseline rule matched it.
categories.recommended_action: Compare the detected version against vendor support status, CISA KEV, and your organization's patch baseline.

categories.label: Accepted baseline
categories.meaning: The detected version matched a configured local baseline rule and met the minimum supported version.
categories.recommended_action: Keep monitoring vendor advisories and patch cadence.

categories.label: Behind baseline
categories.meaning: The detected version matched a configured local baseline rule but is below the minimum supported version.
categories.recommended_action: Schedule remediation or document an exception with compensating controls.

categories.label: EOL or legacy line
categories.meaning: The detected version matched a configured rule that marks it as below an end-of-life or legacy threshold.
categories.recommended_action: Prioritize upgrade, isolation, replacement, or a formally approved exception.

service_flags.label: Remote administration service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm access is restricted, monitored, and protected with strong authentication.

service_flags.label: Database service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm the database is not publicly reachable unless explicitly required and strongly controlled.

service_flags.label: Cleartext or legacy service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm encryption, authentication controls, and whether the service is still required.

service_flags.label: DNS service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm recursion, zone transfer, logging, and failover settings match the intended role.

service_flags.label: Mail service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm relay restrictions, strong authentication, TLS policy, and abuse monitoring.

service_flags.label: Identity or directory service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm exposure is restricted and authentication, directory changes, and privilege changes are logged.

service_flags.label: VPN or edge access service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm MFA, patching, account lifecycle, administrative restrictions, and session monitoring.

service_flags.label: Container or orchestration service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm runtime and control-plane APIs are authenticated, encrypted, and restricted to management networks.

service_flags.label: Monitoring or observability admin service
service_flags.recommended_action: Confirm dashboards, metrics, and alerting interfaces are authenticated and not exposing sensitive data.
